header: What the browser does before a photo is sent (step 70): it checks the file, finds the ONE face, and cuts the square around it. The three steps that need a real browser (decode, find the face, cut) are `deps`, so the rest can be tested with stand-ins; the real ones are in browserDeps.ts. If anything fails the person gets a sentence, never a crash, and nothing is sent.
